scope: Review corrections to the x86 decoder/profile tests, removal of an invalid chain-corruption detector, and an aligned native CMPXCHG16B atomicity fix. This receipt is not CPU ISA certification, a live VM campaign, performance qualification, SMP qualification, or release evidence.

source.inputScope: DoryDBTX86, DoryMachinePC, DoryJITRuntimeC, DoryIR, DoryJITRuntime, their DBTX86/PC test suites, and Package.swift; this is a bounded source manifest, not the entire product dependency graph.

verification.note: The filtered run builds the package test bundle; only DBTX86 and MachinePC suites are counted. Duration is test execution, not clean compilation wall time.

buildRetry.reason: After removal of the uncommitted initializer parameter, SwiftPM retained a PC test object referencing the obsolete initializer ABI. The accepted run followed a clean of only the isolated scratch build. No runtime tests executed in the failed link attempt.

corrections: Ignore REX preceding later legacy prefixes; preserve correct high-byte register selection and replacement REX semantics.
Decode entropy instruction operand widths by execution mode and reject REP-prefixed aliases as entropy operations.
Filter unsupported entropy features through public and persisted profile construction until CPUID and execution are implemented together.
Correct ModRM-group generation and malformed/mislabeled SSE3/AVX negative-test vectors.
Document reserved profile names and admission assessment without claiming implemented persisted-profile migration.

Replace non-atomic two-half CMPXCHG16B with a genuinely lock-free aligned 128-bit compare-exchange on ARM64, retaining conservative fallback elsewhere; validate against concurrent ordinary generated stores.

rejectedExperiment.name: chainTransitionInvariantVerification
reasons: The Swift check surrounds an entire native dispatcher entry, not every raw chain edge, and cannot identify the first corrupting block.
Baseline memory prologues legitimately refresh context FP/LR words.
Tier-one uses a separate saved host register bank; the added tier-one register-only test never initializes or arms the checked words.
Unchanged generated code layout does not prove unchanged timing, and post-return context comparisons do not establish ABI preservation.

limitations: No live VM or candidate-bound production workload was run in this review.
The removed detector was not replaced by a valid native boundary oracle; combined predictor reliability remains open.
The atomicity regression qualifies a bounded aligned direct helper path, not all SMP, split-lock, MMIO, DMA or memory-ordering behavior.
Historical passing fixtures and these tests do not qualify new release bytes.
The user's existing build directory and pre-existing long-running SwiftPM process were preserved.
